messages:
maria: small help request 1: opened a PR to align Ruby streaming reconnect semantics with Go client. CI is green except windows-ruby-3.1 failing one test for stream reconnect on ECONNRESET. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1278

leo: can you paste the failing log? is it a timeout or assertion?

maria: here's the gist: `Faraday::TimeoutError: execution expired` after the reconnect attempt. locally can't repro on linux/mac. logs show a read timeout inside the reconnect loop.

ci-bot: windows-ruby-3.1 job failed: test_stream_reconnect (exit 1). Full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/7921

anya: Windows sockets have different nonblocking behavior. Two quick ideas: use IO.select with a short deadline instead of sleeping loops, and enable SO_KEEPALIVE on the socket. both helped in other SDKs.

sam: also check CRLF handling and ephemeral port reuse on Windows CI container. sometimes the egress NAT on windows images causes different timings.

maria: minimal repro in sampleapp is just Net::HTTP streaming read with a rescue on Errno::ECONNRESET. I'll try adding `socket.setsockopt(Socket::SOL_SOCKET, Socket::SO_KEEPALIVE, true)` and switching read loop to IO.select.

leo: if we still see flakiness, gate the test behind an env var like `CI_WINDOWS_FLAKY=true` and open a follow-up issue to track root cause. prefer a small code tweak + docs note in sampleapp README about Windows quirks.

maria: ok will push a patch with socket opts + IO.select change and add a short "Windows streaming notes" section to the sampleapp README describing the workaround and tests to run. @leo can you review after I push?

ci-bot: maria pushed commit 1f3a8d. windows-ruby-3.1 job retriggered.

maria: thanks all. will update this thread once CI stabilizes. :crossed_fingers:

leo: thanks! :thumbsup:

anya: appreciate the sampleapp doc addition for community contributors on Windows.

maria: noted, and I filed issue #1420 to track parity work across SDKs for streaming reconnection semantics.
